zh-CN: 标签筛选固定把“可能重复”和“未压缩”放在“全部标签”之后，超过 20 行时在面板内滚动；特殊标签随界面语言切换。
仓库概览的“标签”指标可打开全部标签视图，展示项目数并可直接应用筛选。
键盘左右方向键翻页保留当前滚动位置，仓库排序选择改为更紧凑的字段与方向显示。
列表支持一键复制项目名称并收紧列距；全选框移除重复说明，搜索框收缩并在聚焦时展开，窄窗口队列统计保持一行。
运行日志跨应用重启保留并恢复最近 300 条有效记录，补记关键维护、迁移和错误动作；设置日志不记录密码内容。
不更改 SQLite 仓库格式、用户资料位置或现有记录，无需迁移或重建数据。
en-US: The tag filter keeps Possible duplicate and Uncompressed directly after All tags, scrolls internally beyond 20 rows, and translates app-provided special tags with the interface.
The Tags metric opens an all-tags view with item counts and direct Warehouse filtering.
Left and right arrow pagination preserves the current scroll position, and Warehouse sort choices use compact field and direction labels.
List rows support copying item names and use tighter columns; select-all omits its repeated explanation, search shrinks and expands on focus, and queue statistics stay in one row at narrow widths.
Runtime logs persist across app restarts, restore the latest 300 valid entries, and cover key maintenance, migration, and failure events without recording password values.
The SQLite Warehouse format, user-data locations, and existing records are unchanged; no migration or rebuild is required.
